author: bardic-inspiration
name: Ironbark Ring Mail
summary: Ring mail laced with living bark that slowly knits wounds.
description: The bark is grown in place rather than forged, and it pushes up through the rings each spring. It smells of rain.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. When you take a Short Rest, you regain an extra 1d4 hit points.
